landing.seoDescription: Catch the rhythm of nature and leave your trace forever. Start discovering location-based experiences with TraceAtlas!
landing.heroText: Discover every natural wonder, from mountains and forests to hidden routes. Keep every memory on the map like a gift and leave your trace forever.

footer.description: Catch the rhythm of nature and leave your trace forever. Save every moment you discover with TraceAtlas, share your routes, and join a community of explorers. Turn your adventure into a digital atlas.

home.seoDescription: Discover hidden places and popular routes around you on the map. Explore real experiences shared by the TraceAtlas community.

about.seoDescription: Discover the story of TraceAtlas, a modern platform designed to preserve your memories and create your own digital atlas.
about.ogDescription: Learn more about TraceAtlas, designed to preserve your memories and help you build your own digital atlas.
about.twitterDescription: Map your memories and build your own digital atlas with TraceAtlas.
about.structuredDescription: TraceAtlas is a platform designed to preserve your memories and help you create your own digital atlas.
about.heroText: TraceAtlas was designed not only to map the roads you travel, but to immortalize the memories gathered along them.
about.whyParagraph1: We want to keep the feeling of discovery alive in the modern world. Whether you are in unknown city streets or deep in nature, what matters is not only where you are, but what you feel there.
about.whyParagraph2: This platform lets travelers create their own digital atlas, note favorite places, and keep their passion for discovery in an organized archive.
about.developerParagraph1: I am a software enthusiast who loves writing code, exploring modern technologies, and bringing creative ideas to life in the digital world.
about.developerParagraph2: TraceAtlas is a personal project I built both to improve myself and to create something enjoyable. I hope you enjoy using it!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Disclosure Text
privacy.subtitle: This text was prepared to demonstrate the technical capability of the project.
privacy.projectText: This application (TraceAtlas) is an individual project prepared by Eyüp Kaya to demonstrate software development skills. There is no commercial company or legal entity such as TraceAtlas Technology.
privacy.dataIntro: To demonstrate that the project works, the system processes the following data in the database:
privacy.purposeIntro: Collected data is used only for education and portfolio presentation:

purposeItems.label: Technical Demo:
purposeItems.text: To enable communication between the frontend (React) and backend (C# .NET).

purposeItems.label: Map Functions:
purposeItems.text: To display the places marked by users on the map again.

purposeItems.label: Security Tests:
purposeItems.text: To test JWT tokens and authorization mechanisms.

privacy.sharingText: Because this project is not commercial, your data is never shared with advertising companies or third-party data brokers.
privacy.sharingNote: Data stored on the project server (hosting/cloud) is kept on the infrastructure of the relevant cloud provider.
retentionRows: Deleted while the project is live or upon request.

Right to request a copy of my data
Right to remove locations and photos I shared

copyrightItems: Copying or distribution without written permission is prohibited.
It cannot be used for commercial purposes.
